review.method: Agent self-review (Claude Code) of exact page-text spans from the a7 page-text package against the printed clause structure visible in the text layer; conditions, exceptions, tailoring instructions and applicability limits typed as qualifiers; permissions and recommendations kept separate from obligations; cross-document citations recorded as unresolved relationships; no visual PDF inspection.
unresolved_issues: Agent self-review only: the reviewing agent authored and checked these annotations; no human or independent review was performed.

Review used the exact verified pypdf layout text layer of the MIL-STD-1472H body component from the a7 corpus package; the separate notice component is not reviewed; PDF pages were not rendered or visually inspected, and this text layer splits many words (for example 'syste m', 's hall'), which are preserved verbatim.
Only the selected scope (1.1, 1.3 and 5.5.4 through 5.5.4.4.3.4.2) is reviewed; 5.5.4.4.4 onward (including Figure 34 exposure limits), the rest of section 5 and all other pages remain unreviewed.
Compound clauses are decomposed into derived child records whose identities are authored, not printed source numbering; obligation record counts are not atomic-requirement counts.
